title: Why every company is building their own AI model in 2026

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Every company is building their own AI model in 2026 — and it’s changing everything.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just hype — it’s a competitive necessity for survival.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s when custom AI models became faster, cheaper, and more accurate than ever before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’re using open-source frameworks like Llama 3 to build models tailored to their data.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects everyone from healthcare to retail, making services smarter and more personal.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? AI is no longer a luxury — it’s a must-have for innovation.

lines.speaker: Nova
